known.reason: The live instance the 2026-08-21 chip capture measured, still present. `if _env_tree and args.tree: args.tree = _env_tree` fires precisely BECAUSE the caller named a tree, so a caller who points at a two-path fixture is answered about the shared corpus — measured once at a pass over 8309 tracked paths of a tree nobody asked about.
